question: When cross-border capacity is still free after the last intraday cross-zonal gate closure, what may transmission operators use it for?
reply: {"gold_answers": "yes", "gold_reason": "Article 17(3) of Regulation 2019/943 states that where cross-zonal capacity is available after the intraday cross-zonal gate closure time, TSOs shall use it for the exchange of balancing energy or for the operation of the imbalance netting process. verdict.gold_reason: Article 17(3) of Regulation 2019/943 states that where cross-zonal capacity is available after the intraday cross-zonal gate closure time, TSOs shall use it for the exchange of balancing energy or for the operation of the imbalance netting process. This matches the reference answer.

other_articles.why: Paragraph 9 says allocated capacity unused for balancing energy exchange is released for shorter-activation balancing energy exchange or imbalance netting. This addresses a different situation (capacity allocated for balancing capacity), not capacity left after intraday gate closure.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question says 'may' while the article says 'shall'. The question is otherwise a close paraphrase of Article 17(3), so the intended answer is clear.
